kitDescription: Liberalio is a Wind SR charge-shot Attacker whose whole kit keys off full-charge shots and Full Burst entry. Every full-charge landing fires a five-hit additional-damage rider on the target, and landing one on the core gives her a long 60s Attack Damage buff that effectively stays up all fight. Entering Full Burst gives her a very short 3s ATK surge and hands a Charge Speed buff to the lowest-final-ATK Burst III ally (never herself, since she is permanently immune to charge-speed changes). Against the single stage boss her Raging Current mode is always the active one, granting a permanent +231% Attack Damage after her first landed charge; the alternate Gentle Current mode can never trigger in a solo raid. Her burst is a self 10s Attack Damage buff plus a heavy 925% nuke that lands just before the Full Burst window opens.

verdictRationale: No REAL-GOTCHA found: all nine kit lines are FAITHFUL (7) or DOCUMENTED_GAP (2 — Gentle Current clamp and charge-speed immunity, both missing-primitive, verbatim-recorded, dormant in the control comp). The blind re-derivations converged mechanically (S5 32-pass/5-author-skip GREEN vs shipped; S6 structurally identical on all seven blocks), and the two genuine blind-vs-driver divergences both resolved in the driver's favor on evidence tier: the rider multiplicity (driver MEASURED 5×40.5=202.5 — user-confirmed, single-hit read 0.70 cold, in-FB crit-step pairs reading x1.3333 exactly — superseding S6's flagged ambiguity) and excludeSelf on the charge-speed grant (S6 itself judged it strictly more faithful). The one encoding change this gauntlet produced (Raging Current passive→shotFired) was driven by the blind test asserting the prose's trigger identity and independently preferred by S2b — the pipeline catching a real, if small (~0.2%), over-credit. Discrimination holds: every load-bearing line has a failing nearest-wrong counterfactual (level-9 magnitude rows, single-hit rider, top-3 misparse, requiresCore at coreHitRate 0, all-allies retarget, passive S2, sub-cadence duration windows), and S2d confirms 20/20 GREEN. Owner spot-checks for the same-model residual: (1) the 5-hit rider reading is strong but indirect — the multiplicity itself rests on totals-fit plus popup/crit-step reads, worth one frame-counted confirmation per the blind's recipe; (2) the requiresCore gate is engine-binary, so refresh cadence at 0<coreHitRate<1 is untested (irrelevant at scope-lock coreHitRate 1); (3) doc hygiene only — the override note still contains the stale 'approximated by the engine as top-3-ATK allies' sentence contradicting the later FIXED entry, and '202.5% core-hit procs' loosely describes the ungated rider; behavior is correct, the prose is not.
